subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Social Engineering Attacks
description: A short lesson to help you apply Social Engineering Attacks.

hook.text: A hacker doesn't break into the system. They call the help desk, pretend to be the CEO, and get the password.

buildup.text: Social engineering exploits human trust, not technical flaws. It's the most effective attack vector.

discovery.text: Phishing emails account for over 90% of successful cyberattacks. One click opens the whole network.

twist.text: AI-generated deepfake voices can now impersonate executives in real-time phone calls.

climax.text: The best firewall in the world can't stop an employee from clicking a convincing fake email.

punchline.text: Hack the human. Skip the firewall. It works.

quiz.question: What percentage of cyberattacks involve phishing?
